finding.observation: The verifier classifies an UNKNOWN obligation as physical-only pending only when its reason set is exactly {PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED}. If minimum_fidelity=T4_PHYSICAL and physical_required=true while the best current evidence is T3_TARGET_TRACE_REPLAY, evaluation adds both BELOW_MINIMUM_FIDELITY and PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. The obligation therefore does not enter physical_only_pending_obligation_ids and overall status remains UNKNOWN instead of READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_ACCEPTANCE.
finding.why_it_matters: The phase contract says READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_ACCEPTANCE is reached after all non-physical mandatory obligations pass and remaining T4-only obligations are explicitly listed. A true T4-only obligation is a natural case for minimum_fidelity=T4_PHYSICAL, so the present exact-reason-set test can make the readiness gate unreachable for a semantically valid obligation encoding.
finding.counterhypothesis: The intended data model may require physical_required=true obligations to keep minimum_fidelity at the highest non-physical level already satisfiable before handoff (for example T3), reserving physical_required as the only T4 marker. If that is the intended invariant, it is not currently enforced by schema or validator and needs a deterministic rejection test for T4_PHYSICAL + physical_required=true rather than silent UNKNOWN classification.

minimal_reproduction.expected_by_handoff_contract: READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_ACCEPTANCE with obligation explicitly listed as T4-only pending, unless the combination itself is declared invalid
minimal_reproduction.current_code_path: UNKNOWN because reasons={BELOW_MINIMUM_FIDELITY, PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED} fails the exact-set physical-only classification

test_gap: Existing test test_physical_required_remains_ready_for_physical_not_physically_accepted uses default minimum_fidelity=T2 and observation fidelity=T2, so it does not exercise the T4 minimum-fidelity case.
required_resolution: Either classify UNKNOWN reasons that are exclusively physical-readiness reasons (including BELOW_MINIMUM_FIDELITY when minimum_fidelity is T4) as physical-only pending
or define/enforce the invariant that physical_required=true obligations must declare a pre-T4 minimum_fidelity and add fail-closed schema/validator tests
add an explicit regression test for minimum_fidelity=T4_PHYSICAL + physical_required=true + clean T3 evidence
